newsitem.title: USA: AFLAC to try to raise 1997 oper shr 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: AFLAC to try to raise 1997 oper shr 17 pct.

text.p: AFLAC Inc said Tuesday that its goal was to increase operating earnings per share by 17 percent this year, excluding the impact of translating Japanese yen into U.S. dollars.

AFLAC, an international holding company that does business in insurance, reported operating earnings of $0.65 per share in the second quarter, compared to $0.59 for the same quarter a year ago. The earnings excluded realized investment gains or losses as well as the sale of six television stations, it said.
Net earnings were $2.14 per share against $0.59, it added in a statement.

"In the United States, our second quarter results were extremely strong," the company said. "The fact that we can achieve our target rate of earnings per share growth in this challenging environment attests to the strength and resilience of our operation."
First Call's consensus among analysts forecast earnings of $2.62 per share for 1997.
